meta.note: DEMO TRADING CHANNELS — structured reference for digital/electronic trading venues a farmer can sell through. Labeled DEMO_CHANNEL; production would sync from the eNAM registry, APMC notifications, and FPO program listings. Fees and rules change — always verify on the official portal before transacting.

channels.name: eNAM — Electronic National Agriculture Market
channels.operator: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
channels.description: Online bidding platform linking APMC mandis across India. A farmer registered at an eNAM-integrated mandi can receive bids from traders in other states on the same lot — price discovery without moving produce first.
channels.coverage: 1,000+ integrated mandis across India, including APMCs across Maharashtra
channels.fees: No platform fee for farmers; regular APMC market fees apply at the mandi
channels.settlement: Payment credited directly to the farmer's Aadhaar-linked bank account after sale
channels.howToJoin: Register at an eNAM-integrated APMC with Aadhaar and bank details; the integrated-mandi list is on the portal

channels.name: APMC Electronic Auctions (e-Auction)
channels.operator: State APMC market committees (e.g., Vashi, Pune, Lasalgaon)
channels.description: Several Maharashtra APMCs run computerized auction halls where lots are bid digitally inside the market, replacing open outcry for select commodities. Every bid is recorded, reducing cartel influence.
channels.coverage: Selected APMCs in Maharashtra — commodity-specific (e.g., onion lanes at Lasalgaon/Pimpalgaon, fruits & vegetables at Vashi)
channels.fees: Standard APMC charges (market fee, hamali, weighment) as displayed at the mandi
channels.settlement: Same-day sale memo; payment via the APMC as per its rules
channels.howToJoin: No separate registration — arrive at the e-auction lane with the gate pass; the lot enters the digital auction roll

channels.name: FPO Digital Procurement Programs
channels.description: FPOs and institutional buyers (processors, exporters, retail chains) run procurement programs where graded, aggregated lots are contracted digitally — often at pre-agreed, quality-linked prices.
channels.coverage: District-level FPOs across Maharashtra; volumes vary by season
channels.fees: Membership/service charges vary by FPO; many programs are free for member farmers
channels.settlement: Per the purchase agreement — advance or on-delivery payment
channels.howToJoin: Join your local FPO; Kisan360's FPO Pooling workspace can prepare a graded lot for submission
channels.source: DEMO_SEED — illustrative; FPO programs change by district
